channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Bristol Rovers Advance in FA Cup
item.description: Ending a six-game winless streak, League Two club Bristol Rovers defeated League One team Cambridge United 2-0 at the Memorial Stadium. This victory secures Rovers a spot in the second round of the tournament.

item.title: Lampard Argues Coventry Deserved Penalty
item.description: Following a loss to Everton where three refereeing calls went against his squad, Coventry manager Frank Lampard stated that an incident involving a hair pull warranted a penalty kick.

item.title: Midterm Losses Linked to Weak Trump Narrative
item.description: Donald Trump and the Republican Party faced difficulties in framing their historical setback in the United States midterm elections. Analysts point to an unpersuasive stance regarding Iran as a contributing factor.

item.title: Crackdown on POK Protests Leaves 20 Feared Dead
item.description: Authorities cracked down on demonstrations in Pakistan-administered Kashmir over escalating living expenses. Up to 20 individuals are feared dead amidst the unrest.

item.title: Khawaja Says Australian Squad Knew of Ball Tampering
item.description: According to Usman Khawaja, every member of the Australian squad was aware of sandpaper being used to alter the ball during the 2018 final Test match against South Africa.

item.title: Washington Calls on Beijing to Meet Busan Trade Terms
item.description: The United States is pressing China to fulfill obligations from the Busan agreement, which was designed to reduce technological curbs and tariffs. Advancement depends on Beijing executing those promises.

item.title: OpenAI Faces Lawsuit Over ChatGPT Poisoning Script
item.description: OpenAI is facing legal action following allegations that its artificial intelligence model, ChatGPT, generated instructions for creating a fatal poison.

item.title: Media Outlets in Ireland and Bulgaria Receive Threats
item.description: Following a series of false bomb threats targeting commercial flights, news organizations located in Bulgaria and Ireland have now received security threats.

item.title: OpenAI Seeks $11 Billion in Ongoing Financing Round
item.description: OpenAI is currently in the process of securing an extra $11 billion. This ongoing funding effort is projected to finalize within the upcoming weeks.

item.title: Reports Claim China Recruited Executive to Monitor Nvidia CEO
item.description: Chinese intelligence allegedly enlisted Megaspeed leader Alice Huang to gather details regarding U.S. artificial intelligence processors and attempt influence. This was reported by The New York Times concerning Nvidia head Jensen Huang.

item.title: কার্যকর উপায়ে প্রতিদিনকে আগের দিনের চেয়ে ভালো করার পদ্ধতি
item.description: গতকালের তুলনায় আজকের দিনটিকে কীভাবে আরও সফল ও কার্যকর করা সম্ভব, সেই বিষয়ে কিছু ব্যবহারিক পরামর্শ আলোচনা করা হয়েছে। জীবনকে উন্নত করার জন্য এই পদ্ধতিগুলো অনুসরণ করা যেতে পারে।

item.title: New South Wales Students Compete in Sydney Spelling Bee Finals
item.description: Primary pupils triumphed over 200,000 rivals throughout New South Wales to advance to the Sydney championship. Contestants learned that a single vowel can determine the ultimate outcome.

item.title: Supreme Court Issues Contempt Notice to Kerala Congress Officials
item.description: The Supreme Court has issued a contempt notice directed at office-bearers belonging to the Kerala Congress. The legal action follows a social media post concerning the Chief Justice of India.

item.title: Paraguayan President Santiago Pena Faces Impeachment
item.description: Lawmakers advanced impeachment actions against Santiago Pena to remove former presidential immunity. This occurred despite his earlier attempt to resign amid a banking catastrophe.

item.title: Paraguay Senate Ousts President Santiago Pena Following Bank Collapse
item.description: Paraguay's Senate removed President Santiago Pena from office due to the failure of a major financial institution linked to his administration. The collapse has locked millions of customer accounts alongside public healthcare and pension assets.

item.title: SpaceX Outlines Major Plans for Starlink Mobile Carrier Service
item.description: SpaceX announced ambitions to establish Starlink Mobile as a primary telecommunications provider. The Musk-led enterprise operates numerous direct-to-cell satellites and now aims to develop a terrestrial 5G network infrastructure.

item.title: Khawaja Discusses 2018 Ball-Tampering in Upcoming Book
item.description: In his forthcoming autobiography, Usman Khawaja claims Cricket Australia never questioned him regarding the 2018 Cape Town incident.

item.title: Lampard Laments Critical Calls After Everton Loss
item.description: Coventry manager Frank Lampard expressed disappointment following three crucial refereeing decisions that impacted their 3-1 defeat to Everton.

item.title: Alcaraz Overcomes Fritz in Paris to Assist Jodar
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz saved two match points to defeat Taylor Fritz at the Paris Masters, helping fellow Spaniard Rafael Jodar reach the ATP finals.

item.title: Milind Deora Protests BMC Over Ashray Yojana Snub
item.description: An unsatisfied Milind Deora wrote to the BMC chief regarding his omission from a November 6, 2026 housing project event.

item.title: Barry's Brace Propels Everton Past Coventry
item.description: Thierno Barry scored two goals as Everton overturned a deficit to defeat Coventry 3-1, advancing to fifth place in the Premier League.

item.title: WTA Chief Apologizes to Pegula Over Hot Mic Incident
item.description: WTA head Valerie Camillo issued an apology to Jessica Pegula after a broadcast picked up a remark labeling Mirra Andreeva a diva.

item.title: Pope Leo Begins South American Tour in Uruguay
item.description: Pope Leo commenced a 12-day tour of three South American nations by arriving in Uruguay, shortly following his recent lung cancer surgery.

item.title: Sikkim High Court Halts Intra-Court Appeals
item.description: Operating with only two active judges, the Sikkim High Court is currently unable to process intra-court appeals.

item.title: California Court Denies Legal Fee Request in Condo Parking Dispute
item.description: An Orange County legal battle between property owners over garage spot 38G-a ended with a ruling for WCST Enterprises. Despite winning the case, the company was refused its request for nearly $292,544 in legal expenses.

item.title: US Justice Department Departures Follow Midterm Elections
item.description: Following the midterms, multiple prosecutors departed the Trump administration's Justice Department. These exits occurred amid disagreements over pursuing cases against targeted individuals.

item.title: Idaho Ranch Secures 1,686 Acres to Protect Migrating Deer
item.description: The Atchley family placed their 125-year-old Flying A Ranch under a conservation agreement. This pact preserves agricultural use, blocks future construction, and aids local wildlife movement.

item.title: Additional Evidence Permitted in Sonia Gandhi Voter List Case
item.description: A judicial body has authorized the submission of supplementary proof regarding the voter list lawsuit involving Sonia Gandhi.

item.title: High Court Judge Openings Fall to 26% While Backlogs Grow
item.description: Vacant positions for high court judges have decreased to a ten-year low of 26 percent. Even with this reduction, pending legal cases continue to accumulate.

item.title: Elon Musk Indicates Cybertruck Production May End
item.description: Elon Musk has signaled the conclusion of Cybertruck production. The shift aims to clear manufacturing capacity for driverless Cybercabs.

item.title: National Medical Commission Expands Postgraduate Seats by 9,783
item.description: The NMC has introduced 9,783 new postgraduate medical slots. This expansion brings the country's total availability to 68,305 positions.

item.title: Hugo Keenan Scores Three Tries as Ireland Defeats Argentina
item.description: Hugo Keenan secured a hat-trick of tries in Dublin as Ireland defeated Argentina with six tries. The victory opened the home leg of the Nations Championship with bonus points.

item.title: Raith Rovers Claim Scottish Championship Top Spot After Draw
item.description: A scoreless Fife derby allowed Raith Rovers to capture first place in the Scottish Championship on goal difference. Visitors Dunfermline Athletic finished the match in third place with equal points.

item.title: Cornell Academic Senate Issues No Confidence Vote Against Executives
item.description: Professors at Cornell expressed a lack of confidence in the school's administration. This follows a civil lawsuit where an anonymous plaintiff accused the university of failing to safeguard her from sexual assault.

item.title: KPop Demon Hunters 4K Blu-ray Available Below Streaming Cost
item.description: The physical 4K Ultra HD release of KPop Demon Hunters is currently priced lower than a standard monthly tier of Netflix. This offers an economical alternative for fans who previously maintained the streaming service primarily for the animated movie.

item.title: Gaza Mass Ceremony Unites Two Hundred Fifty Couples in Marriage
item.description: Amid ongoing conflict, a large collective wedding ceremony took place in the Gaza Strip. The gathering united 250 couples to celebrate matrimonial unions despite the hostilities.

item.title: Cheaper Gold Rates Boost Jewelry Purchases During Dhanteras
item.description: Lower bullion rates stimulated higher consumer demand for ornaments during the Dhanteras festival. The price reduction contributed to increased retail activity in the jewelry sector.

item.title: Apple Reports Rapid Growth of Duo-Optimized Applications
item.description: Apple announced that the count of applications optimized for Duo has reached 100,000. Additionally, thousands of new compatible programs are being added each day.

item.title: United States Department of Treasury Penalizes Canadian Entities
item.description: The American financial department implemented measures against financial networks connected to Iran. These actions included placing sanctions on specific businesses based in Canada.

item.title: Mirwaiz Reports Ongoing Confinement and Blocked Friday Prayers
item.description: Mirwaiz Umar Farooq stated he remained confined to his residence for a sixth consecutive day while Friday congregational prayers were prohibited. In a prior address, he cited international reports regarding regional political detainees and civil rights.

item.title: Houthi Authorities Report Thirty Fatalities from Market Bombardment
item.description: According to Houthi officials, multiple aerial attacks struck a marketplace in the Taiz region. The targeted territory is under Houthi control and has experienced intense combat since autumn.

item.title: Stephen Miller Named Trump White House Chief of Staff
item.description: Longtime adviser Stephen Miller, known for shaping strict immigration strategies for Donald Trump since 2016, has been appointed as the new White House chief of staff.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence Shares Bounce Back After Market Losses
item.description: Technology equities recovered following a period of heavy selling by shareholders who feared a Democratic win might decelerate artificial intelligence progress.

item.title: Global Equities Decline Following Democratic Midterm Wins and AI Concerns
item.description: European and Asian markets experienced steep declines, mirroring earlier drops on Wall Street, with the FTSE index falling 1.9%. The market sell-off was triggered by anxieties over artificial intelligence following the Democratic Party's success in the midterm elections.

item.title: Demonstrators Breach Microsoft Data Center Location in Amsterdam
item.description: Activists forced their way into an Amsterdam facility belonging to Microsoft. European data centers frequently draw protests because of their high electricity and water consumption.

item.title: Former Zoho Employee Shares Three-Year Struggle with Burnout
item.description: Kewal Agrawal described facing severe anxiety and loss of confidence during three years at Zoho. Moving to a smaller company helped him recover his professional enthusiasm.

item.title: Kris Jenner Details Confrontation Over Lamar Odom's Infidelity
item.description: On The Kardashians, Kris Jenner shared an episode where she and daughter Khloe Kardashian confronted Lamar Odom at a hotel following discoveries of substance abuse and cheating.

item.title: CPI(M) Figure Biman Basu Withdraws Remarks on Past Industrial Stance
item.description: On November 5, Suvendu Adhikari argued that earlier forced land acquisitions under Buddhadeb Bhattacharjee harmed the region's economic growth, prompting a later retraction by Biman Basu.

item.title: Live Science Readers Discuss Willingness to Travel to Mars Despite Dangers
item.description: An audience poll by Live Science gathered opinions on whether individuals would travel to the Red Planet despite known medical hazards.

item.title: Real Madrid and PSG Eyeing Goalkeeper Zion Suzuki
item.description: Real Madrid and Paris Saint-Germain are reportedly tracking Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki. Additionally, Inter Milan is considering a bid for Crystal Palace defender Chris Richards.

item.title: CBSE Schedules Class 10 and 12 Board Examinations for February 16
item.description: The Central Board of Secondary Education has announced that its high school board tests for the tenth and twelfth grades will commence on February 16.

item.title: Rights group questions Samserganj police encounter after suspect killed
item.description: A civil rights association has highlighted flaws in the police report regarding the October 27 shooting of Samaul Sheikh in Murshidabad and requested the suspension of CID personnel. Sheikh, suspected of killing BJP activist Sujit Mondal on August 28, died in the afternoon shootout.

item.title: Trump names Stephen Miller as new Chief of Staff
item.description: US President Donald Trump has elevated longtime adviser Stephen Miller to the position of Chief of Staff, succeeding Susie Wiles.

item.title: Sao Paulo GP marks early battleground for F1 championship
item.description: This weekend features the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, highlighting Ferrari's driver pairing dynamic and setting the stage for the upcoming racing championship.

item.title: Three foreign nationals indicted in US over AI impersonation fraud
item.description: Authorities in the United States have arrested and charged three men for utilizing artificial intelligence to mimic the likeness and voices of corporate leaders and lawyers, defrauding organizations of over $100 million by tricking staff into transferring funds.

item.title: ট্রাম্পের হোয়াইট হাউসের চিফ অব স্টাফ হিসেবে মিলারের দায়িত্ব গ্রহণ
item.description: সোমবার হোয়াইট হাউসের চিফ অব স্টাফের দায়িত্ব গ্রহণ করছেন স্টিফেন মিলার। তিনি দেশের প্রথম নারী চিফ অব স্টাফ সুসি ওয়াইলসের স্থলাভিষিক্ত হবেন।

item.title: US Democrats push for halt on new datacenters following elections
item.description: Following the US midterm elections, Senator Bernie Sanders and various newly elected Democrats have revived demands for a temporary halt on datacenter construction. This move worries the tech sector over potential setbacks to massive AI infrastructure projects.

item.title: Election Commission allows deleted voters in seven regions to re-register
item.description: The Election Commission announced that voters whose names were removed across seven states and union territories can register again without needing to submit Form 6.

item.title: Chainalysis reports security breach affecting customer access tokens
item.description: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis stated that a coordinated cyber assault involving artificial intelligence and data interception compromised login credentials and tokens belonging to its entire client base.

item.title: Thomas Markle Detained in US Over Explicit Child Material
item.description: American law enforcement has taken Thomas Markle into custody following the discovery of explicit images allegedly depicting children.
